title: Google's AI Grab Bag: 5 New Ways AI Is About to Change Your Daily Apps (and What to Try First)
angle: Google just integrated AI with Canva, YouTube Music, and Instacart. Here are the top 5 practical, everyday uses you can start leveraging today to make your life easier, from generating playlists to designing quick flyers.
rationale: This offers immediate, actionable value to a broad audience, transforming a tech update into practical tips they can use now.

source_articles.title: Google AI Mode now integrates with Canva, YouTube Music and Instacart
